literal_external_legs.literal_loop_convention: Two vertices -i*T/sqrt(kappa) and the harmonic propagator give i*Sigma, so the inverse scalar propagator is p^2-mu+Sigma. The scalar-graviton seagull and massless tadpole pieces are scaleless in dimensional regularization. The finite trace contribution is not dropped.
literal_external_legs.on_shell_mass_statement: This pure-gravity scalar self-energy has Sigma(mu)=0 exactly in D at the tree pole. It does not assert zero total mass shift from heavy/contact/matter loops, an exact interacting mass, or a completed vacuum/LSZ construction.

literal_external_legs.whole_external_leg_factor: Z=1/(1+Sigmaprime), so four scalar LSZ legs give Z^2=1-2Sigmaprime+O(hbar^2). Their IR part is-mu*A_tree/(8pi^2 kappa EP), exactly the self-MU part of the prescribed S278 factor.
